tool_input.description: Debug actual exception message for noNullElements on Iterable with null at index 1

result: Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/ValidateAgentTest.java` — a self-contained JUnit 5 test class with 87 test methods covering `Validate`'s full API (exclusiveBetween, inclusiveBetween, finite, isAssignableFrom, isInstanceOf, isTrue, matchesPattern, noNullElements, notBlank, notEmpty, notNaN, notNull, validIndex, validState, and the deprecated constructor), including boundary values, `null` inputs, NaN/infinity, and custom-message/varargs overloads. All tests pass via `./_tools/test.sh`.
